title: Paper City, Isometric
prompt: A tiny isometric pastel city block built like a paper model: rounded buildings, trees, a park, little cars circling the streets. The orthographic camera orbits a full turn as a seamless loop.
description: How to build a cel-shaded pastel diorama in EEVEE with an orthographic isometric turntable and arc-length car loops that close seamlessly.

brief.prompt: A tiny isometric pastel city block built like a paper model: rounded buildings, trees, a park, little cars circling the streets. The orthographic camera orbits a full turn as a seamless loop.

techniques: kit.toon with per-colour tinted shadow tones
orthographic camera at true isometric elevation with kit.orbit sweep=360
inverted-hull outline with backface-culled emission material
one mesh per building for printed windows (kit.mesh)
arc-length car paths with unwrapped heading via kit.animate
layered card base from bevelled kit.box slabs
kit.scatter with avoid circles for flower dots
